name: Guangzhou Haige Communications Group Incorporated Company
summary: Guangzhou Haige Communications Group Incorporated Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wireless communications, Beidou navigation, aerospace, and digital intelligence ecology businesses in China. The company offers shortwave communication, ultra-shortwave communication, satellite communication, digital trunking, artificial and unmanned collaborative communication, 5G, and digital communication.
